### Alert

Static message with an icon, a title and a description. Variants: default, destructive, success, warning. Composed from native elements (no Reka primitive): ElfAlert with ElfAlertTitle and ElfAlertDescription.

Components: `ElfAlert`, `ElfAlertTitle`, `ElfAlertDescription`

- variant options: `default`, `destructive`, `success`, `warning` (default `default`)

Props:

- `ElfAlert variant` (variant union, default default): Visual style and default icon.
- `ElfAlert role` ('alert' | 'status' | 'none', default alert for destructive, otherwise status): Live region role; none renders no role (use for notices already on the page at load).
- `ElfAlert showIcon` (boolean, default true): Show the icon (attribute: show-icon).
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfAlert default: ElfAlertTitle and ElfAlertDescription
- ElfAlert icon: replaces the default variant icon (a 16px SVG)

Accessibility:

- Only an alert inserted after load is announced; use v-if after a user action, and role="none" for static notices.
- Do not move focus to it or auto-dismiss it.
- Say the severity in the title, never in color or icon alone.

Examples:

#### Custom Icon

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAlert, ElfAlertDescription, ElfAlertTitle } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { Rocket } from '@lucide/vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid max-w-lg gap-4">
    <ElfAlert>
      <template #icon>
        <Rocket />
      </template>
      <ElfAlertTitle>New season kickoff</ElfAlertTitle>
      <ElfAlertDescription>The game manual is out. Read it before Thursday's meeting.</ElfAlertDescription>
    </ElfAlert>
    <ElfAlert :show-icon="false" role="none">
      <ElfAlertTitle>Title only, no icon</ElfAlertTitle>
    </ElfAlert>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAlert, ElfAlertDescription, ElfAlertTitle } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfAlert class="max-w-lg">
    <ElfAlertTitle>Practice moved to Saturday</ElfAlertTitle>
    <ElfAlertDescription>
      The gym is booked on Friday evening, so the build session starts at 10:00 on Saturday instead.
    </ElfAlertDescription>
  </ElfAlert>
</template>
```

#### Dynamic

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAlert, ElfAlertDescription, ElfAlertTitle, ElfButton } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const failed = ref(false)
const saved = ref(false)

function save(ok: boolean) {
  failed.value = !ok
  saved.value = ok
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid max-w-lg gap-4">
    <div class="flex gap-2">
      <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="save(true)">
        Save
      </ElfButton>
      <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="save(false)">
        Save with an error
      </ElfButton>
    </div>
    <!-- Inserted after the page loaded, so the live region role announces it. -->
    <ElfAlert v-if="failed" variant="destructive">
      <ElfAlertTitle>Save failed</ElfAlertTitle>
      <ElfAlertDescription>The roster could not be saved. Try again in a moment.</ElfAlertDescription>
    </ElfAlert>
    <ElfAlert v-if="saved" variant="success">
      <ElfAlertTitle>Roster saved</ElfAlertTitle>
    </ElfAlert>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Variants

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAlert, ElfAlertDescription, ElfAlertTitle } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid max-w-lg gap-4">
    <ElfAlert>
      <ElfAlertTitle>Heads up</ElfAlertTitle>
      <ElfAlertDescription>Registration for the Istanbul Regional opens next week.</ElfAlertDescription>
    </ElfAlert>
    <ElfAlert variant="success">
      <ElfAlertTitle>Robot inspection passed</ElfAlertTitle>
      <ElfAlertDescription>You are cleared to queue for your first match.</ElfAlertDescription>
    </ElfAlert>
    <ElfAlert variant="warning">
      <ElfAlertTitle>Battery 3 is below 12 V</ElfAlertTitle>
      <ElfAlertDescription>Swap it for a charged battery before the next match.</ElfAlertDescription>
    </ElfAlert>
    <ElfAlert variant="destructive">
      <ElfAlertTitle>Could not save the schedule</ElfAlertTitle>
      <ElfAlertDescription>Check your connection and try again.</ElfAlertDescription>
    </ElfAlert>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Progress

Progress bar built on Reka UI Progress (role=progressbar). Determinate with v-model (0..max) or indeterminate with a null value. Always give it a name with label, aria-label or aria-labelledby.

Components: `ElfProgress`

- size options: `sm`, `default`, `lg` (default `default`)

Props:

- `modelValue` (number | null): Current value, bound with v-model. null (or omitted) makes the bar indeterminate: no aria-valuenow, animated.
- `max` (number, default 100): Maximum value (aria-valuemax).
- `size` ('sm' | 'default' | 'lg', default default): Bar thickness (6, 8 or 12px).
- `label` (string): Accessible name (aria-label) when there is no visible label.
- `getValueText` ((value, max) => string): Sets aria-valuetext, for example "7 of 12 tasks".
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged onto the track.
- `indicatorClass` (string | array | object): Merged onto the filled indicator, for example bg-success (attribute: indicator-class).

Accessibility:

- Name the bar: label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby pointing at the visible label.
- Progress changes are not announced by themselves; announce completion with a status message.
- The indeterminate animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfProgress } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref(20)
function step(delta: number) {
  value.value = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value.value + delta))
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-80 max-w-full gap-3">
    <ElfProgress v-model="value" label="Upload progress" />
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
      <ElfButton variant="outline" size="sm" :disabled="value <= 0" @click="step(-20)">
        Less
      </ElfButton>
      <ElfButton variant="outline" size="sm" :disabled="value >= 100" @click="step(20)">
        More
      </ElfButton>
      <output class="ml-auto text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{{ value }}%</output>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfProgress } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfProgress :model-value="64" label="Robot build progress" class="w-80 max-w-full" />
</template>
```

#### Indeterminate

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfProgress } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-80 max-w-full gap-2">
    <p id="progress-sync-label" class="text-sm font-medium">
      Syncing the match schedule
    </p>
    <!-- No value: the bar animates and exposes no aria-valuenow, because the duration is unknown. -->
    <ElfProgress :model-value="null" aria-labelledby="progress-sync-label" />
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Sizes

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfProgress } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-80 max-w-full gap-4">
    <ElfProgress :model-value="30" size="sm" label="Small bar" />
    <ElfProgress :model-value="55" label="Default bar" />
    <ElfProgress :model-value="80" size="lg" label="Large bar" />
  </div>
</template>
```

#### With Label

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfProgress } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { computed } from 'vue'

const done = 7
const total = 12
const value = computed(() => done / total * 100)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-80 max-w-full gap-2">
    <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between text-sm">
      <span id="progress-tasks-label" class="font-medium">Build tasks</span>
      <span class="text-muted-foreground">{{ done }} of {{ total }} done</span>
    </div>
    <ElfProgress
      :model-value="value"
      aria-labelledby="progress-tasks-label"
      :get-value-text="() => `${done} of ${total} tasks done`"
    />
  </div>
</template>
```

### Avatar

Person or team image with an initials fallback, built on Reka UI Avatar. ElfAvatar (size) contains ElfAvatarImage and ElfAvatarFallback; ElfAvatarGroup overlaps several.

Components: `ElfAvatar`, `ElfAvatarImage`, `ElfAvatarFallback`, `ElfAvatarGroup`

- size options: `sm`, `default`, `lg`, `xl` (default `default`)

Props:

- `ElfAvatar size` ('sm' | 'default' | 'lg' | 'xl', default default): Diameter (24, 32, 40 or 56px).
- `ElfAvatar label` (string): Accessible name; exposes the avatar as one role=img and hides its content from assistive technology.
- `ElfAvatarImage src` (string): Required image URL. Add alt. The image replaces the fallback once loaded.
- `ElfAvatarFallback name` (string): Full name; shows its initials (first and last word) when the slot is empty.
- `ElfAvatarFallback delayMs` (number): Wait before showing the fallback, to avoid a flash while the image loads (attribute: delay-ms).
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfAvatarFallback default: custom fallback content (an icon, +3)
- ElfAvatarGroup default: ElfAvatar items

Accessibility:

- Give ElfAvatarImage an alt (the name, or empty when the name is shown beside it).
- Use label on a standalone avatar, and aria-label on a group.
- Avatars are not interactive; name the link or button you wrap one in.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAvatar, ElfAvatarFallback, ElfAvatarImage } from '@xouyi/elfui'

// A self-contained image so the example needs no network.
const photo = `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64"><rect width="64" height="64" fill="#7c5cd6"/><circle cx="32" cy="26" r="11" fill="#e9e3ff"/><path d="M10 64c2-16 12-22 22-22s20 6 22 22z" fill="#e9e3ff"/></svg>')}`
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
    <ElfAvatar>
      <ElfAvatarImage :src="photo" alt="Ayşe Demir" />
      <ElfAvatarFallback name="Ayşe Demir" />
    </ElfAvatar>
    <ElfAvatar>
      <!-- Not an image: the fallback is shown when the source fails to load. -->
      <ElfAvatarImage src="data:image/png;base64,broken" alt="Mehmet Kaya" />
      <ElfAvatarFallback name="Mehmet Kaya" />
    </ElfAvatar>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Fallback

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAvatar, ElfAvatarFallback } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { User } from '@lucide/vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-6">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
      <ElfAvatar>
        <ElfAvatarFallback name="Zeynep Arslan" />
      </ElfAvatar>
      <div class="text-sm">
        <p class="font-medium">
          Zeynep Arslan
        </p>
        <p class="text-muted-foreground">
          Software lead
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <ElfAvatar label="Unknown member">
      <ElfAvatarFallback>
        <User class="size-4" />
      </ElfAvatarFallback>
    </ElfAvatar>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Group

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAvatar, ElfAvatarFallback, ElfAvatarGroup } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const members = ['Ayşe Demir', 'Mehmet Kaya', 'Zeynep Arslan', 'Can Yıldız']
</script>

<template>
  <ElfAvatarGroup aria-label="Software subteam, 7 members">
    <ElfAvatar v-for="name in members" :key="name">
      <ElfAvatarFallback :name="name" />
    </ElfAvatar>
    <ElfAvatar>
      <ElfAvatarFallback>+3</ElfAvatarFallback>
    </ElfAvatar>
  </ElfAvatarGroup>
</template>
```

#### Sizes

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAvatar, ElfAvatarFallback } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const sizes = ['sm', 'default', 'lg', 'xl'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-end gap-4">
    <ElfAvatar v-for="size in sizes" :key="size" :size="size" :label="`Avatar, ${size} size`">
      <ElfAvatarFallback name="Novatron Robotics" />
    </ElfAvatar>
  </div>
</template>
```

### GradientText

Inline gradient text (bg-clip-text) on a span by default. Real, selectable text; presets follow the theme and pass 4.5:1 on every theme background.

Components: `ElfGradientText`

Props:

- `variant` ('brand' | 'aurora' | 'sunset' | 'forest', default brand): Colour preset. brand blends the theme primary into its foreground; the others switch between a light and a dark set by color-scheme.
- `from / via / to` (string): Custom CSS colours (tokens work: var(--elf-primary)). They override the preset stops.
- `direction` ('r' | 'l' | 'b' | 't' | 'br' | 'bl' | 'tr' | 'tl', default r): Gradient direction.
- `animate` (boolean, default false): Slow shimmer; static under prefers-reduced-motion.
- `as` (string | Component, default span): Element to render.
- `asChild` (boolean, default false): Render the child element with the gradient (attribute: as-child).
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes.

Slots:

- default: the text

Accessibility:

- The text stays real text: selectable, searchable and read as written.
- In forced-colors mode the gradient is replaced by CanvasText.
- Custom from/via/to colours are not checked: keep 4.5:1 against the background (3:1 for large text).
- Use it for short decorative emphasis, not for long paragraphs.

Examples:

#### Animated

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfGradientText } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <p class="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">
    <ElfGradientText variant="aurora" animate>
      Shimmering, unless you prefer reduced motion
    </ElfGradientText>
  </p>
</template>
```

#### Custom

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfGradientText } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
    <ElfGradientText from="var(--elf-primary)" to="var(--elf-destructive-text)" direction="br">
      Primary into destructive text
    </ElfGradientText>
    <ElfGradientText from="var(--elf-success-text)" via="var(--elf-primary)" to="var(--elf-warning-text)">
      Three stops from theme tokens
    </ElfGradientText>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfGradientText } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <p class="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
    Build the next <ElfGradientText>robot</ElfGradientText> together.
  </p>
</template>
```

#### Heading

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfGradientText } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <h2 class="text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-balance">
    Ship faster with
    <ElfGradientText variant="sunset" direction="br">
      accessible components
    </ElfGradientText>
  </h2>
</template>
```

#### Variants

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfGradientText } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const variants = ['brand', 'aurora', 'sunset', 'forest'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <ul class="grid gap-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
    <li v-for="variant in variants" :key="variant">
      <ElfGradientText :variant="variant">
        {{ variant }}
      </ElfGradientText>
    </li>
  </ul>
</template>
```

### Tooltip

Short non-interactive hint on hover or keyboard focus, built on Reka UI Tooltip. Compose ElfTooltip > ElfTooltipTrigger (as-child around a button) + ElfTooltipContent. Wrap related tooltips in one ElfTooltipProvider to share the open delay.

Components: `ElfTooltip`, `ElfTooltipTrigger`, `ElfTooltipContent`, `ElfTooltipProvider`

Props:

- `ElfTooltip open / defaultOpen` (boolean): Controlled (v-model:open) or initial open state.
- `ElfTooltip delayDuration` (number): Milliseconds before opening on hover; overrides the provider.
- `ElfTooltipProvider delayDuration` (number, default 400): Open delay shared by every tooltip below it (attribute: delay-duration).
- `ElfTooltipProvider skipDelayDuration` (number, default 300): Window after a tooltip closes in which the next one opens instantly.
- `ElfTooltipContent side` ('top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left', default top): Preferred side; flips when there is no room.
- `ElfTooltipContent align` ('start' | 'center' | 'end', default center): Alignment against the trigger.
- `ElfTooltipContent sideOffset` (number, default 6): Gap to the trigger in pixels (attribute: side-offset).
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by ElfTooltipContent; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfTooltipTrigger default: the described element (use as-child)
- ElfTooltipContent default: a short plain-text hint

Accessibility:

- The tooltip describes the trigger (aria-describedby); give the trigger its own name, for example aria-label on an icon button.
- Opens on hover and keyboard focus, closes on Escape. Never put links, buttons or essential information inside it.
- Touch screens cannot hover: do not hide information that touch users need behind a tooltip.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfTooltip, ElfTooltipContent, ElfTooltipTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
    <ElfTooltip v-model:open="open">
      <ElfTooltipTrigger as-child>
        <ElfButton variant="outline">
          Details
        </ElfButton>
      </ElfTooltipTrigger>
      <ElfTooltipContent>Opens a read-only summary</ElfTooltipContent>
    </ElfTooltip>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      open = {{ open }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfTooltip, ElfTooltipContent, ElfTooltipTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfTooltip>
    <ElfTooltipTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Hover or focus me
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfTooltipTrigger>
    <ElfTooltipContent>
      Saved to your team library
    </ElfTooltipContent>
  </ElfTooltip>
</template>
```

#### Icon Buttons

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Bold, Italic, Link } from '@lucide/vue'
import { ElfButton, ElfTooltip, ElfTooltipContent, ElfTooltipProvider, ElfTooltipTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const actions = [
  { label: 'Bold', icon: Bold },
  { label: 'Italic', icon: Italic },
  { label: 'Insert link', icon: Link },
]
</script>

<template>
  <!-- One provider shares the open delay: after the first tooltip, neighbours open instantly. -->
  <ElfTooltipProvider :delay-duration="300" :skip-delay-duration="500">
    <div class="flex gap-1">
      <ElfTooltip v-for="action in actions" :key="action.label">
        <ElfTooltipTrigger as-child>
          <ElfButton variant="ghost" size="icon" :aria-label="action.label">
            <component :is="action.icon" />
          </ElfButton>
        </ElfTooltipTrigger>
        <ElfTooltipContent>{{ action.label }}</ElfTooltipContent>
      </ElfTooltip>
    </div>
  </ElfTooltipProvider>
</template>
```

#### Sides

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfTooltip, ElfTooltipContent, ElfTooltipProvider, ElfTooltipTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const sides = ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <ElfTooltipProvider :delay-duration="150">
    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <ElfTooltip v-for="side in sides" :key="side">
        <ElfTooltipTrigger as-child>
          <ElfButton variant="outline" size="sm" class="capitalize">
            {{ side }}
          </ElfButton>
        </ElfTooltipTrigger>
        <ElfTooltipContent :side="side">
          Appears on the {{ side }}
        </ElfTooltipContent>
      </ElfTooltip>
    </div>
  </ElfTooltipProvider>
</template>
```

#### With Shortcut

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfKbd, ElfTooltip, ElfTooltipContent, ElfTooltipTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfTooltip>
    <ElfTooltipTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Save
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfTooltipTrigger>
    <ElfTooltipContent class="flex items-center gap-2">
      Save changes <ElfKbd>Ctrl S</ElfKbd>
    </ElfTooltipContent>
  </ElfTooltip>
</template>
```

### Popover

Anchored interactive panel, built on Reka UI Popover. Compose ElfPopover > ElfPopoverTrigger (as-child around a button) + ElfPopoverContent; ElfPopoverClose closes it, ElfPopoverAnchor anchors it elsewhere. Non-modal by default; modal traps focus.

Components: `ElfPopover`, `ElfPopoverTrigger`, `ElfPopoverAnchor`, `ElfPopoverContent`, `ElfPopoverClose`

Props:

- `ElfPopover open / defaultOpen` (boolean): Controlled (v-model:open) or initial open state.
- `ElfPopover modal` (boolean, default false): Trap focus and make the page behind inert.
- `ElfPopoverContent side` ('top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left', default bottom): Preferred side; flips when there is no room.
- `ElfPopoverContent align` ('start' | 'center' | 'end', default center): Alignment against the trigger.
- `ElfPopoverContent sideOffset` (number, default 4): Gap to the trigger in pixels (attribute: side-offset).
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by ElfPopoverContent; merged with base classes (default width w-72).

Slots:

- ElfPopoverTrigger default: the toggle (use as-child)
- ElfPopoverContent default: the panel content

Accessibility:

- The panel is role=dialog; focus moves in on open and returns to the trigger on close; Escape closes.
- Name the panel with aria-label or aria-labelledby when it has no visible heading.
- Use a tooltip for non-interactive hints and a dialog or sheet for long content.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfPopover, ElfPopoverClose, ElfPopoverContent, ElfPopoverTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
    <ElfPopover v-model:open="open">
      <ElfPopoverTrigger as-child>
        <ElfButton variant="outline">
          Filters
        </ElfButton>
      </ElfPopoverTrigger>
      <ElfPopoverContent class="grid gap-3">
        <p class="text-sm">
          Show only items that are low in stock.
        </p>
        <ElfPopoverClose as-child>
          <ElfButton size="sm">
            Apply
          </ElfButton>
        </ElfPopoverClose>
      </ElfPopoverContent>
    </ElfPopover>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      open = {{ open }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfInput, ElfLabel, ElfPopover, ElfPopoverContent, ElfPopoverTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfPopover>
    <ElfPopoverTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Rename item
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfPopoverTrigger>
    <ElfPopoverContent>
      <div class="grid gap-3">
        <p class="text-sm font-medium">
          Rename item
        </p>
        <div class="grid gap-2">
          <ElfLabel for="popover-name">
            Name
          </ElfLabel>
          <ElfInput id="popover-name" default-value="Battery 12V" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </ElfPopoverContent>
  </ElfPopover>
</template>
```

#### Modal

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfPopover, ElfPopoverContent, ElfPopoverTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <!-- modal traps focus and makes the page behind inert, like a dialog anchored to its trigger. -->
  <ElfPopover modal>
    <ElfPopoverTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Modal popover
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfPopoverTrigger>
    <ElfPopoverContent class="grid gap-3">
      <p class="text-sm">
        Focus stays inside until you press Escape or choose an action.
      </p>
      <ElfButton size="sm" variant="secondary">
        Confirm
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfPopoverContent>
  </ElfPopover>
</template>
```

#### Sides

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfPopover, ElfPopoverContent, ElfPopoverTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const sides = ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
    <ElfPopover v-for="side in sides" :key="side">
      <ElfPopoverTrigger as-child>
        <ElfButton variant="outline" size="sm" class="capitalize">
          {{ side }}
        </ElfButton>
      </ElfPopoverTrigger>
      <ElfPopoverContent :side="side" class="w-56">
        <p class="text-sm">
          Opens on the {{ side }} and flips when there is no room.
        </p>
      </ElfPopoverContent>
    </ElfPopover>
  </div>
</template>
```

### HoverCard

Rich preview shown when a link is hovered or focused, built on Reka UI HoverCard. Compose ElfHoverCard > ElfHoverCardTrigger (as-child around a real link) + ElfHoverCardContent. Supplementary only: never opens on touch and is not announced.

Components: `ElfHoverCard`, `ElfHoverCardTrigger`, `ElfHoverCardContent`

Props:

- `ElfHoverCard open / defaultOpen` (boolean): Controlled (v-model:open) or initial open state.
- `ElfHoverCard openDelay` (number, default 700): Milliseconds before opening (attribute: open-delay).
- `ElfHoverCard closeDelay` (number, default 300): Milliseconds before closing after the pointer leaves (attribute: close-delay).
- `ElfHoverCardContent side` ('top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left', default bottom): Preferred side; flips when there is no room.
- `ElfHoverCardContent align` ('start' | 'center' | 'end', default center): Alignment against the trigger.
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by ElfHoverCardContent; merged with base classes (default width w-72).

Slots:

- ElfHoverCardTrigger default: a link (use as-child)
- ElfHoverCardContent default: non-interactive preview content

Accessibility:

- The trigger must be a real link that works without the card; the card is an enhancement for pointer users.
- Opens on keyboard focus and closes on Escape. Put no essential information or interactive elements in it.
- Use a popover for interactive content.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfHoverCard, ElfHoverCardContent, ElfHoverCardTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
    <ElfHoverCard v-model:open="open">
      <ElfHoverCardTrigger as-child>
        <a href="#team" class="text-sm text-primary underline underline-offset-4 outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50">Team Novatron</a>
      </ElfHoverCardTrigger>
      <ElfHoverCardContent class="w-64">
        <p class="text-sm">
          FRC Team 10202, Istanbul.
        </p>
      </ElfHoverCardContent>
    </ElfHoverCard>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      open = {{ open }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAvatar, ElfAvatarFallback, ElfHoverCard, ElfHoverCardContent, ElfHoverCardTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <p class="text-sm">
    Reviewed by
    <ElfHoverCard>
      <ElfHoverCardTrigger as-child>
        <a href="#ayse" class="font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4 outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50">Ayşe Demir</a>
      </ElfHoverCardTrigger>
      <ElfHoverCardContent>
        <div class="flex gap-3">
          <ElfAvatar>
            <ElfAvatarFallback name="Ayşe Demir" />
          </ElfAvatar>
          <div class="grid gap-1">
            <p class="text-sm font-medium">
              Ayşe Demir
            </p>
            <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Software lead. Joined in 2025.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ElfHoverCardContent>
    </ElfHoverCard>
    on Friday.
  </p>
</template>
```

#### Delays

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfHoverCard, ElfHoverCardContent, ElfHoverCardTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfHoverCard :open-delay="100" :close-delay="100">
    <ElfHoverCardTrigger as-child>
      <a href="#quick" class="text-sm text-primary underline underline-offset-4 outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50">Quick preview</a>
    </ElfHoverCardTrigger>
    <ElfHoverCardContent side="top" class="w-64">
      <p class="text-sm">
        Opens after 100 ms and closes 100 ms after the pointer leaves.
      </p>
    </ElfHoverCardContent>
  </ElfHoverCard>
</template>
```

### DropdownMenu

Action menu opened from a button, built on Reka UI DropdownMenu. Compose ElfDropdownMenu > ElfDropdownMenuTrigger (as-child around a button) + ElfDropdownMenuContent > items. Items: ElfDropdownMenuItem (@select), ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem (v-model), ElfDropdownMenuRadioGroup (v-model) with ElfDropdownMenuRadioItem, ElfDropdownMenuSub with SubTrigger and SubContent; ElfDropdownMenuLabel, Group, Separator and Shortcut (put ElfKbd inside) structure it.

Components: `ElfDropdownMenu`, `ElfDropdownMenuTrigger`, `ElfDropdownMenuContent`, `ElfDropdownMenuItem`, `ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem`, `ElfDropdownMenuRadioGroup`, `ElfDropdownMenuRadioItem`, `ElfDropdownMenuLabel`, `ElfDropdownMenuGroup`, `ElfDropdownMenuSeparator`, `ElfDropdownMenuShortcut`, `ElfDropdownMenuSub`, `ElfDropdownMenuSubTrigger`, `ElfDropdownMenuSubContent`

Props:

- `ElfDropdownMenu open / defaultOpen` (boolean): Controlled (v-model:open) or initial open state.
- `ElfDropdownMenu modal` (boolean, default true): Make the page behind inert while open.
- `ElfDropdownMenuContent side / align / sideOffset` (side, alignment, number, default bottom / center / 4): Placement against the trigger (attribute: side-offset).
- `ElfDropdownMenuItem variant` ('default' | 'destructive', default default): destructive colours irreversible actions such as delete.
- `ElfDropdownMenuItem inset` (boolean, default false): Indent to line up with indicator items. Also on Label and SubTrigger.
- `ElfDropdownMenuItem disabled` (boolean, default false): Item cannot be activated.
- `ElfDropdownMenuItem @select` ((event) => void): Emitted when the item is activated; call event.preventDefault() to keep the menu open.
- `ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem modelValue` (boolean | 'indeterminate'): Checked state, bound with v-model.
- `ElfDropdownMenuRadioGroup modelValue` (string): Selected value, bound with v-model; each ElfDropdownMenuRadioItem has a value.
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part except ElfDropdownMenu; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfDropdownMenuTrigger default: the button (use as-child)
- ElfDropdownMenuContent default: items, labels, groups, separators, sub menus
- ElfDropdownMenuShortcut default: ElfKbd elements or text

Accessibility:

- The trigger has aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded; give an icon-only trigger an aria-label.
- Arrow keys, Home, End and typeahead move; Enter or Space activates; ArrowRight and ArrowLeft open and close sub menus; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
- Use for actions, not for choosing a form value (use ElfSelect). Confirm destructive actions with a dialog.

Examples:

#### Checkboxes

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  ElfButton,
  ElfDropdownMenu,
  ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem,
  ElfDropdownMenuContent,
  ElfDropdownMenuLabel,
  ElfDropdownMenuSeparator,
  ElfDropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const showStatus = ref(true)
const showSku = ref(false)
const showNotes = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
    <ElfDropdownMenu>
      <ElfDropdownMenuTrigger as-child>
        <ElfButton variant="outline">
          Columns
        </ElfButton>
      </ElfDropdownMenuTrigger>
      <ElfDropdownMenuContent class="w-48" align="start">
        <ElfDropdownMenuLabel>Visible columns</ElfDropdownMenuLabel>
        <ElfDropdownMenuSeparator />
        <ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem v-model="showStatus">
          Status
        </ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
        <ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem v-model="showSku">
          SKU
        </ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
        <ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem v-model="showNotes" disabled>
          Notes (unavailable)
        </ElfDropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
      </ElfDropdownMenuContent>
    </ElfDropdownMenu>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      status = {{ showStatus }}, sku = {{ showSku }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Controlled

```vue
        <ElfDropdownMenuItem>Second</ElfDropdownMenuItem>
      </ElfDropdownMenuContent>
    </ElfDropdownMenu>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      open = {{ open }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### ContextMenu

Menu for an area opened by right-click, long-press, Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key, built on Reka UI ContextMenu. Same parts and styles as ElfDropdownMenu: ElfContextMenu > ElfContextMenuTrigger (as-child around a focusable element) + ElfContextMenuContent > ElfContextMenuItem, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup/RadioItem, Label, Group, Separator, Shortcut, Sub/SubTrigger/SubContent. Never the only way to reach an action.

Components: `ElfContextMenu`, `ElfContextMenuTrigger`, `ElfContextMenuContent`, `ElfContextMenuItem`, `ElfContextMenuCheckboxItem`, `ElfContextMenuRadioGroup`, `ElfContextMenuRadioItem`, `ElfContextMenuLabel`, `ElfContextMenuGroup`, `ElfContextMenuSeparator`, `ElfContextMenuShortcut`, `ElfContextMenuSub`, `ElfContextMenuSubTrigger`, `ElfContextMenuSubContent`

Props:

- `ElfContextMenu modal` (boolean, default true): Make the page behind inert while open.
- `ElfContextMenu pressOpenDelay` (number, default 700): Long-press duration in milliseconds that opens the menu on touch (attribute: press-open-delay).
- `ElfContextMenuTrigger disabled` (boolean, default false): Turns the context menu off for the area; the native menu shows instead.
- `ElfContextMenuItem variant` ('default' | 'destructive', default default): destructive colours irreversible actions such as delete.
- `ElfContextMenuItem inset` (boolean, default false): Indent to line up with indicator items. Also on Label and SubTrigger.
- `ElfContextMenuItem @select` ((event) => void): Emitted when the item is activated; call event.preventDefault() to keep the menu open.
- `ElfContextMenuCheckboxItem modelValue` (boolean | 'indeterminate'): Checked state, bound with v-model.
- `ElfContextMenuRadioGroup modelValue` (string): Selected value, bound with v-model; each ElfContextMenuRadioItem has a value.
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part except ElfContextMenu; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfContextMenuTrigger default: the area (use as-child on a focusable element)
- ElfContextMenuContent default: items, labels, groups, separators, sub menus

Accessibility:

- Make the trigger area focusable (tabindex=0), give it a role and a name that mentions the menu, so Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key open it.
- The same actions must also be reachable without right-click (a button or a dropdown menu): touch users must long-press.
- Arrow keys, Home, End and typeahead move; Enter or Space activates; ArrowRight and ArrowLeft open and close sub menus; Escape closes and returns focus to the area.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  ElfContextMenu,
  ElfContextMenuContent,
  ElfContextMenuItem,
  ElfContextMenuLabel,
  ElfContextMenuSeparator,
  ElfContextMenuShortcut,
  ElfContextMenuTrigger,
  ElfKbd,
} from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const last = ref('none')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-3">
    <ElfContextMenu>
      <ElfContextMenuTrigger as-child>
        <div
          role="group"
          aria-label="Item card. Press Shift+F10 or the context menu key for actions."
          tabindex="0"
          class="flex h-32 w-full max-w-sm items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed p-4 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50"
        >
          Right-click, long-press, or focus and press Shift+F10
        </div>
      </ElfContextMenuTrigger>
      <ElfContextMenuContent class="w-56">
        <ElfContextMenuLabel>Battery 12V</ElfContextMenuLabel>
        <ElfContextMenuItem @select="last = 'open'">
          Open
          <ElfContextMenuShortcut>
            <ElfKbd>Enter</ElfKbd>
          </ElfContextMenuShortcut>
        </ElfContextMenuItem>
        <ElfContextMenuItem @select="last = 'rename'">
          Rename
          <ElfContextMenuShortcut>
            <ElfKbd>F2</ElfKbd>
          </ElfContextMenuShortcut>
        </ElfContextMenuItem>
        <ElfContextMenuItem disabled>
          Move (soon)
        </ElfContextMenuItem>
        <ElfContextMenuSeparator />
        <ElfContextMenuItem variant="destructive" @select="last = 'delete'">
          Delete
        </ElfContextMenuItem>
      </ElfContextMenuContent>
    </ElfContextMenu>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      last = {{ last }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Options

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  ElfContextMenu,
  ElfContextMenuCheckboxItem,
  ElfContextMenuContent,
  ElfContextMenuItem,
  ElfContextMenuLabel,
  ElfContextMenuRadioGroup,
  ElfContextMenuRadioItem,
  ElfContextMenuSeparator,
  ElfContextMenuSub,
  ElfContextMenuSubContent,
  ElfContextMenuSubTrigger,
  ElfContextMenuTrigger,
} from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const showGrid = ref(true)
const density = ref('comfortable')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-3">
    <ElfContextMenu>
      <ElfContextMenuTrigger as-child>
        <div
          role="group"
          aria-label="Canvas. Press Shift+F10 or the context menu key for view options."
          tabindex="0"
          class="flex h-32 w-full max-w-sm items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed p-4 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50"
        >
          View options (right-click here)
        </div>
      </ElfContextMenuTrigger>
      <ElfContextMenuContent class="w-56">
        <ElfContextMenuCheckboxItem v-model="showGrid">
          Show grid
        </ElfContextMenuCheckboxItem>
        <ElfContextMenuSeparator />
        <ElfContextMenuLabel>Density</ElfContextMenuLabel>
        <ElfContextMenuRadioGroup v-model="density">
          <ElfContextMenuRadioItem value="comfortable">
            Comfortable
          </ElfContextMenuRadioItem>
          <ElfContextMenuRadioItem value="compact">
            Compact
          </ElfContextMenuRadioItem>
        </ElfContextMenuRadioGroup>
        <ElfContextMenuSeparator />
        <ElfContextMenuSub>
          <ElfContextMenuSubTrigger>Export as</ElfContextMenuSubTrigger>
          <ElfContextMenuSubContent>
            <ElfContextMenuItem>PNG</ElfContextMenuItem>
            <ElfContextMenuItem>SVG</ElfContextMenuItem>
          </ElfContextMenuSubContent>
        </ElfContextMenuSub>
      </ElfContextMenuContent>
    </ElfContextMenu>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      grid = {{ showGrid }}, density = {{ density }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### ScrollArea

Scrolling container with styled scrollbars, built on Reka UI ScrollArea. Native scrolling is kept; the viewport is keyboard focusable. Give ElfScrollArea a height or width (class) and a label.

Components: `ElfScrollArea`, `ElfScrollBar`

Props:

- `type` ('hover' | 'scroll' | 'auto' | 'always', default hover): When the scrollbars are visible.
- `orientation` ('vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both', default vertical): Which scrollbars to render.
- `scrollHideDelay` (number, default 600): Milliseconds before a bar hides for hover and scroll (attribute: scroll-hide-delay).
- `label` (string): Accessible name; makes the focusable viewport a role=region.
- `viewportClass` (string | array | object): Classes for the scrolling viewport (attribute: viewport-class).
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged onto the root; set its height or width here.

Slots:

- default: the scrollable content

Accessibility:

- The viewport is focusable (tabindex=0) so arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End scroll it; pass label to name it.
- Scrollbars are decorative; content must not depend on dragging them.
- Do not nest scroll areas or wrap the whole page in one.

Examples:

#### Both

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfScrollArea } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const rows = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, r) => r + 1)
const cols = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, c) => c + 1)
</script>

<template>
  <ElfScrollArea orientation="both" label="Score grid" class="h-56 w-full max-w-md rounded-md border">
    <table class="text-sm">
      <caption class="sr-only">
        Match scores by round and station
      </caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col" class="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
            Round
          </th>
          <th v-for="c in cols" :key="c" scope="col" class="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
            Station {{ c }}
          </th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr v-for="r in rows" :key="r" class="border-t">
          <th scope="row" class="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium">
            {{ r }}
          </th>
          <td v-for="c in cols" :key="c" class="px-3 py-2 text-muted-foreground">
            {{ r * c }}
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </ElfScrollArea>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfScrollArea, ElfSeparator } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const items = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => `Fastener M${i + 3} x 20`)
</script>

<template>
  <ElfScrollArea label="Inventory list" class="h-72 w-64 rounded-md border">
    <div class="p-4">
      <h4 class="mb-3 text-sm font-medium">
        Fasteners
      </h4>
      <template v-for="item in items" :key="item">
        <div class="text-sm">
          {{ item }}
        </div>
        <ElfSeparator class="my-2" />
      </template>
    </div>
  </ElfScrollArea>
</template>
```

#### Horizontal

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfScrollArea } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const parts = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `Sprocket ${i + 1}` }))
</script>

<template>
  <ElfScrollArea orientation="horizontal" label="Parts gallery" class="w-full max-w-md rounded-md border">
    <div class="flex w-max gap-3 p-4">
      <figure v-for="part in parts" :key="part.id" class="shrink-0">
        <div class="flex h-24 w-32 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-muted text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          #{{ part.id }}
        </div>
        <figcaption class="pt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {{ part.name }}
        </figcaption>
      </figure>
    </div>
  </ElfScrollArea>
</template>
```

#### Types

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfScrollArea } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const types = ['always', 'auto', 'hover', 'scroll'] as const
const lines = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => `Line ${i + 1}`)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
    <div v-for="type in types" :key="type" class="grid gap-1">
      <p class="text-xs font-medium">
        type="{{ type }}"
      </p>
      <ElfScrollArea :type="type" :label="`Scrollbar type ${type}`" class="h-32 rounded-md border">
        <ul class="p-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <li v-for="line in lines" :key="line">
            {{ line }}
          </li>
        </ul>
      </ElfScrollArea>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

### AlertDialog

Modal that demands a decision (destructive confirmation), built on Reka UI AlertDialog. Role alertdialog: focus starts on Cancel, Escape cancels, an outside click never dismisses it.

Components: `ElfAlertDialog`, `ElfAlertDialogTrigger`, `ElfAlertDialogContent`, `ElfAlertDialogHeader`, `ElfAlertDialogTitle`, `ElfAlertDialogDescription`, `ElfAlertDialogFooter`, `ElfAlertDialogCancel`, `ElfAlertDialogAction`

Props:

- `ElfAlertDialog open / defaultOpen` (boolean): Controlled (v-model:open) or initial open state.
- `ElfAlertDialogAction variant` (ButtonVariants['variant'], default default): Button style of the confirming action; use destructive for irreversible actions.
- `ElfAlertDialogAction / ElfAlertDialogCancel size` (ButtonVariants['size'], default default): Button size.
- `ElfAlertDialogCancel variant` (ButtonVariants['variant'], default outline): Button style of the cancel action.
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfAlertDialogTrigger: use as-child with an ElfButton
- ElfAlertDialogAction and ElfAlertDialogCancel both close the dialog; handle the decision with @click on the action

Accessibility:

- Always include ElfAlertDialogTitle and ElfAlertDialogDescription.
- Name the action after what it does ("Delete"), never "OK".
- Use ElfDialog instead when the content is a form or can be dismissed by clicking outside.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAlertDialog, ElfAlertDialogAction, ElfAlertDialogCancel, ElfAlertDialogContent, ElfAlertDialogDescription, ElfAlertDialogFooter, ElfAlertDialogHeader, ElfAlertDialogTitle, ElfButton } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
const removed = ref(0)

function remove() {
  removed.value += 1
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="open = true">
      Remove member
    </ElfButton>
    <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">open = {{ open }}, removed = {{ removed }}</span>
    <ElfAlertDialog v-model:open="open">
      <ElfAlertDialogContent>
        <ElfAlertDialogHeader>
          <ElfAlertDialogTitle>Remove this member?</ElfAlertDialogTitle>
          <ElfAlertDialogDescription>They lose access to every team app immediately.</ElfAlertDialogDescription>
        </ElfAlertDialogHeader>
        <ElfAlertDialogFooter>
          <ElfAlertDialogCancel>Cancel</ElfAlertDialogCancel>
          <ElfAlertDialogAction variant="destructive" @click="remove">
            Remove
          </ElfAlertDialogAction>
        </ElfAlertDialogFooter>
      </ElfAlertDialogContent>
    </ElfAlertDialog>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAlertDialog, ElfAlertDialogAction, ElfAlertDialogCancel, ElfAlertDialogContent, ElfAlertDialogDescription, ElfAlertDialogFooter, ElfAlertDialogHeader, ElfAlertDialogTitle, ElfAlertDialogTrigger, ElfButton } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfAlertDialog>
    <ElfAlertDialogTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Publish roster
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfAlertDialogTrigger>
    <ElfAlertDialogContent>
      <ElfAlertDialogHeader>
        <ElfAlertDialogTitle>Publish the roster?</ElfAlertDialogTitle>
        <ElfAlertDialogDescription>Every member will be notified and the draft is locked.</ElfAlertDialogDescription>
      </ElfAlertDialogHeader>
      <ElfAlertDialogFooter>
        <ElfAlertDialogCancel>Cancel</ElfAlertDialogCancel>
        <ElfAlertDialogAction>Publish</ElfAlertDialogAction>
      </ElfAlertDialogFooter>
    </ElfAlertDialogContent>
  </ElfAlertDialog>
</template>
```

#### Destructive

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAlertDialog, ElfAlertDialogAction, ElfAlertDialogCancel, ElfAlertDialogContent, ElfAlertDialogDescription, ElfAlertDialogFooter, ElfAlertDialogHeader, ElfAlertDialogTitle, ElfAlertDialogTrigger, ElfButton } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfAlertDialog>
    <ElfAlertDialogTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="destructive">
        Delete match log
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfAlertDialogTrigger>
    <ElfAlertDialogContent>
      <ElfAlertDialogHeader>
        <ElfAlertDialogTitle>Delete this match log?</ElfAlertDialogTitle>
        <ElfAlertDialogDescription>
          This permanently removes the log and its scouting notes. This action cannot be undone.
        </ElfAlertDialogDescription>
      </ElfAlertDialogHeader>
      <ElfAlertDialogFooter>
        <ElfAlertDialogCancel>Keep it</ElfAlertDialogCancel>
        <ElfAlertDialogAction variant="destructive">
          Delete
        </ElfAlertDialogAction>
      </ElfAlertDialogFooter>
    </ElfAlertDialogContent>
  </ElfAlertDialog>
</template>
```

### Sheet

Edge-anchored modal panel on Reka UI Dialog: side sheets for forms and navigation, and a bottom sheet for mobile. Same focus trap, Escape and focus restore as ElfDialog; an outside click closes it.

Components: `ElfSheet`, `ElfSheetTrigger`, `ElfSheetContent`, `ElfSheetHeader`, `ElfSheetTitle`, `ElfSheetDescription`, `ElfSheetFooter`, `ElfSheetClose`

- side options: `right`, `left`, `top`, `bottom` (default `right`)
- size options: `sm`, `default`, `lg`, `full` (default `default`)

Props:

- `ElfSheet open / defaultOpen` (boolean): Controlled (v-model:open) or initial open state.
- `ElfSheetContent side` ('top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left', default right): Edge the sheet slides in from. bottom is the mobile pattern (safe-area padding).
- `ElfSheetContent size` ('sm' | 'default' | 'lg' | 'full', default default): Maximum width (left, right) or height (top, bottom); full fills the viewport.
- `ElfSheetContent showCloseButton` (boolean, default true): Show the corner close button (attribute: show-close-button).
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfSheetTrigger and ElfSheetClose: use as-child with an ElfButton

Accessibility:

- Always include ElfSheetTitle and ElfSheetDescription (hide the description with class="sr-only" if needed).
- Use ElfAlertDialog, not a sheet, for confirmations.
- Animations stop under prefers-reduced-motion.

Examples:

#### Bottom Sheet

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfSheet, ElfSheetClose, ElfSheetContent, ElfSheetDescription, ElfSheetFooter, ElfSheetHeader, ElfSheetTitle, ElfSheetTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfSheet>
    <ElfSheetTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Set quantity
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfSheetTrigger>
    <!-- The bottom sheet spans the screen and keeps its content above the home indicator (safe-area padding). -->
    <ElfSheetContent side="bottom">
      <ElfSheetHeader>
        <ElfSheetTitle>Set quantity</ElfSheetTitle>
        <ElfSheetDescription>How many units are on the shelf?</ElfSheetDescription>
      </ElfSheetHeader>
      <div class="flex gap-2">
        <ElfSheetClose v-for="n in [1, 2, 5, 10]" :key="n" as-child>
          <ElfButton variant="secondary" class="h-10 flex-1">
            {{ n }}
          </ElfButton>
        </ElfSheetClose>
      </div>
      <ElfSheetFooter>
        <ElfSheetClose as-child>
          <ElfButton variant="outline" class="max-sm:h-10">
            Cancel
          </ElfButton>
        </ElfSheetClose>
      </ElfSheetFooter>
    </ElfSheetContent>
  </ElfSheet>
</template>
```

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfSheet, ElfSheetContent, ElfSheetDescription, ElfSheetHeader, ElfSheetTitle } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="open = true">
      Open filters
    </ElfButton>
    <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">open = {{ open }}</span>
    <ElfSheet v-model:open="open">
      <ElfSheetContent side="left">
        <ElfSheetHeader>
          <ElfSheetTitle>Filters</ElfSheetTitle>
          <ElfSheetDescription>The open state lives in your component.</ElfSheetDescription>
        </ElfSheetHeader>
      </ElfSheetContent>
    </ElfSheet>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfField, ElfFieldControl, ElfInput, ElfSheet, ElfSheetClose, ElfSheetContent, ElfSheetDescription, ElfSheetFooter, ElfSheetHeader, ElfSheetTitle, ElfSheetTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfSheet>
    <ElfSheetTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Edit item
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfSheetTrigger>
    <ElfSheetContent>
      <ElfSheetHeader>
        <ElfSheetTitle>Edit item</ElfSheetTitle>
        <ElfSheetDescription>Change the name and quantity. Save when you are done.</ElfSheetDescription>
      </ElfSheetHeader>
      <ElfField label="Name">
        <ElfFieldControl>
          <ElfInput default-value="Swerve module" />
        </ElfFieldControl>
      </ElfField>
      <ElfField label="Quantity">
        <ElfFieldControl>

      <ElfSheetFooter>
        <ElfSheetClose as-child>
          <ElfButton variant="outline">
            Cancel
          </ElfButton>
        </ElfSheetClose>
        <ElfButton>Save</ElfButton>
      </ElfSheetFooter>

```

#### Sides

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfSheet, ElfSheetContent, ElfSheetDescription, ElfSheetHeader, ElfSheetTitle, ElfSheetTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const sides = ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
    <ElfSheet v-for="side in sides" :key="side">
      <ElfSheetTrigger as-child>
        <ElfButton variant="outline" class="capitalize">
          {{ side }}
        </ElfButton>
      </ElfSheetTrigger>
      <ElfSheetContent :side="side">
```

```vue
const sizes = ['sm', 'default', 'lg', 'full'] as const

    <ElfSheet v-for="size in sizes" :key="size">
      <ElfSheetTrigger as-child>
        <ElfButton variant="outline" class="capitalize">

        </ElfButton>

            {{ size }} sheet
          </ElfSheetTitle>
          <ElfSheetDescription>On a phone every side sheet leaves a strip of the page visible; from the sm breakpoint the size sets the maximum width.</ElfSheetDescription>
        </ElfSheetHeader>
      </ElfSheetContent>
    </ElfSheet>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Toast

Transient notifications. Mount one ElfToaster per app and call useToast() (or import toast) from anywhere: toast(message, options), toast.success/warning/error, toast.promise, toast.update, toast.dismiss. Built on the Reka UI Toast viewport and manager; the queue is a module singleton that is a no-op on the server.

Components: `ElfToaster`

- variant options: `default`, `success`, `warning`, `destructive` (default `default`)

Props:

- `ElfToaster position` ('top-left' | 'top-center' | 'top-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-center' | 'bottom-right', default bottom-right): Where the stack sits; toasts span the width on small screens.
- `ElfToaster limit` (number, default 3): Maximum toasts visible at once; older ones stay queued.
- `ElfToaster duration` (number, default 5000): Default milliseconds before a toast closes; 0 keeps it until dismissed.
- `ElfToaster hotkey` (string[], default ['F8']): Keys that focus the notification region.
- `ElfToaster closeButton / closeLabel` (boolean / string, default true / Close): Dismiss button and its accessible name (attributes: close-button, close-label).
- `ElfToaster label / announceLabel` (string): Region landmark label ({hotkey} is replaced) and the name read before each toast.
- `toast(message, options)` (ToastOptions): options: description, variant (default | success | warning | destructive), duration, action ({ label, onClick, altText }), id, onClose. Returns the id.
- `toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })` (Promise<T>): Loading toast that becomes success or destructive; returns and rethrows the promise.

Slots:

- No slots: toasts are created through the API.

Accessibility:

- Mount exactly one ElfToaster. Destructive toasts are announced assertively (role=alert), others politely (role=status).
- F8 focuses the region; Escape closes the focused toast; the timer pauses on hover and focus.
- Never put information only in a toast, and do not use one for errors that need a decision.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, useToast } from '@xouyi/elfui'

// Mount one <ElfToaster /> in app.vue; useToast() works from any component.
const { toast } = useToast()
</script>

<template>
  <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="toast('Roster saved', { description: 'Your changes are visible to every member.' })">
    Show toast
  </ElfButton>
</template>
```

#### Promise

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, useToast } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const { toast } = useToast()

function upload(ok: boolean) {
  const task = new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    setTimeout(() => (ok ? resolve('match-12.csv') : reject(new Error('Network error'))), 1500)
  })
  toast.promise(task, {
    loading: 'Uploading scouting data',
    success: name => `${name} uploaded`,
    error: 'Upload failed',
  }).catch(() => {})
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex gap-2">
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="upload(true)">
      Upload
    </ElfButton>
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="upload(false)">
      Upload and fail
    </ElfButton>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Variants

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, useToast } from '@xouyi/elfui'

const { toast } = useToast()
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="toast('New message', { description: 'Mentor Aylin replied to your post.' })">
      Default
    </ElfButton>
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="toast.success('Roster saved')">
      Success
    </ElfButton>
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="toast.warning('Battery 3 is low', { description: 'Swap it before the next match.' })">
      Warning
    </ElfButton>
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="toast.error('Save failed', { description: 'The roster could not be saved.' })">
      Destructive
    </ElfButton>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### With Action

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, useToast } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const { toast } = useToast()
const restored = ref(0)

function remove() {
  toast('Item removed', {
    description: 'It will be deleted for good in a few seconds.',
    duration: 8000,
    action: { label: 'Undo', altText: 'Undo removing the item', onClick: () => { restored.value += 1 } },
  })
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="remove">
      Remove item
    </ElfButton>
    <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">restored = {{ restored }}</span>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Collapsible

A single show and hide region with an animated height, built on Reka UI Collapsible. ElfCollapsibleTrigger toggles ElfCollapsibleContent.

Components: `ElfCollapsible`, `ElfCollapsibleTrigger`, `ElfCollapsibleContent`

Props:

- `ElfCollapsible open / defaultOpen` (boolean): Controlled (v-model:open) or initial open state.
- `ElfCollapsible disabled` (boolean, default false): Prevents toggling.
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by ElfCollapsibleContent; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfCollapsibleTrigger: use as-child with an ElfButton

Accessibility:

- Give an icon-only trigger an aria-label.
- Do not hide required form fields in a closed region.
- The height animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfCollapsible, ElfCollapsibleContent, ElfCollapsibleTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ElfCollapsible v-model:open="open" class="w-full max-w-sm space-y-2">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
      <ElfCollapsibleTrigger as-child>
        <ElfButton variant="outline">
          {{ open ? 'Hide' : 'Show' }} filters
        </ElfButton>
      </ElfCollapsibleTrigger>
      <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">open = {{ open }}</span>
    </div>
    <ElfCollapsibleContent class="rounded-md border px-4 py-3 text-sm">
      Season, event and alliance filters live here.
    </ElfCollapsibleContent>
  </ElfCollapsible>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChevronsUpDown } from '@lucide/vue'
import { ElfButton, ElfCollapsible, ElfCollapsibleContent, ElfCollapsibleTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfCollapsible class="w-full max-w-sm space-y-2">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
      <h4 class="text-sm font-semibold">
        3 starred repositories
      </h4>
      <ElfCollapsibleTrigger as-child>
        <ElfButton variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Toggle repositories">
          <ChevronsUpDown />
        </ElfButton>
      </ElfCollapsibleTrigger>
    </div>
    <div class="rounded-md border px-4 py-2 text-sm">
      novatron/hq
    </div>
    <ElfCollapsibleContent class="space-y-2">
      <div class="rounded-md border px-4 py-2 text-sm">
        novatron/kit
      </div>
      <div class="rounded-md border px-4 py-2 text-sm">
        novatron/scout
      </div>
    </ElfCollapsibleContent>
  </ElfCollapsible>
</template>
```

#### Disabled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfCollapsible, ElfCollapsibleContent, ElfCollapsibleTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfCollapsible disabled class="w-full max-w-sm space-y-2">
    <ElfCollapsibleTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Advanced settings (locked)
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfCollapsibleTrigger>
    <ElfCollapsibleContent class="rounded-md border px-4 py-3 text-sm">
      Not reachable while disabled.
    </ElfCollapsibleContent>
  </ElfCollapsible>
</template>
```

### Accordion

Stacked collapsible sections on Reka UI Accordion. ElfAccordion (type single or multiple) contains ElfAccordionItem (value) with an ElfAccordionTrigger heading button and an ElfAccordionContent region.

Components: `ElfAccordion`, `ElfAccordionItem`, `ElfAccordionTrigger`, `ElfAccordionContent`

Props:

- `ElfAccordion type` ('single' | 'multiple'): Required. single opens one item at a time; multiple allows several.
- `ElfAccordion collapsible` (boolean, default false): In single mode, lets the open item be closed.
- `ElfAccordion modelValue / defaultValue` (string | string[]): Open item value (single) or values (multiple); bind with v-model.
- `ElfAccordion disabled` (boolean, default false): Disables every item.
- `ElfAccordionItem value` (string): Required unique value; disabled disables the item.
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfAccordionTrigger icon: replaces the chevron

Accessibility:

- Triggers are buttons inside headings; arrow keys, Home and End move between them and skip disabled items.
- Use short, specific trigger labels and do not nest accordions.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAccordion, ElfAccordionContent, ElfAccordionItem, ElfAccordionTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref<string | undefined>('a')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="w-full max-w-lg space-y-3">
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      open = {{ open ?? 'none' }}
    </p>
    <ElfAccordion v-model="open" type="single" collapsible>
      <ElfAccordionItem value="a">
        <ElfAccordionTrigger>First section</ElfAccordionTrigger>
        <ElfAccordionContent>One item is open at a time.</ElfAccordionContent>
      </ElfAccordionItem>
      <ElfAccordionItem value="b">
        <ElfAccordionTrigger>Second section</ElfAccordionTrigger>
        <ElfAccordionContent>Opening this closes the first.</ElfAccordionContent>
      </ElfAccordionItem>
    </ElfAccordion>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAccordion, ElfAccordionContent, ElfAccordionItem, ElfAccordionTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfAccordion type="single" collapsible default-value="rules" class="w-full max-w-lg">
    <ElfAccordionItem value="rules">
      <ElfAccordionTrigger>Who can join the team?</ElfAccordionTrigger>
      <ElfAccordionContent>Any high-school student in Istanbul can apply. Members are provisioned by an admin.</ElfAccordionContent>
    </ElfAccordionItem>
    <ElfAccordionItem value="meetings">
      <ElfAccordionTrigger>When do we meet?</ElfAccordionTrigger>
      <ElfAccordionContent>Tuesday and Thursday evenings, plus Saturdays during build season.</ElfAccordionContent>
    </ElfAccordionItem>
    <ElfAccordionItem value="dues">
      <ElfAccordionTrigger>Is there a fee?</ElfAccordionTrigger>
      <ElfAccordionContent>No. Sponsors and fundraisers cover registration and parts.</ElfAccordionContent>
    </ElfAccordionItem>
  </ElfAccordion>
</template>
```

#### Disabled

```vue

</script>

<template>

    </ElfAccordionItem>
  </ElfAccordion>
</template>
```

#### Multiple

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfAccordion, ElfAccordionContent, ElfAccordionItem, ElfAccordionTrigger } from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfAccordion type="multiple" :default-value="['build', 'code']" class="w-full max-w-lg">
    <ElfAccordionItem value="build">
      <ElfAccordionTrigger>Build</ElfAccordionTrigger>
      <ElfAccordionContent>Chassis, mechanisms and wiring.</ElfAccordionContent>
    </ElfAccordionItem>
    <ElfAccordionItem value="code">
      <ElfAccordionTrigger>Code</ElfAccordionTrigger>
      <ElfAccordionContent>Autonomous routines and vision.</ElfAccordionContent>
    </ElfAccordionItem>
    <ElfAccordionItem value="outreach">
      <ElfAccordionTrigger>Outreach</ElfAccordionTrigger>
      <ElfAccordionContent>Workshops, sponsors and social media.</ElfAccordionContent>
    </ElfAccordionItem>
  </ElfAccordion>
</template>
```

### NavigationMenu

Top-level site navigation (a nav landmark) with flyout panels, built on Reka UI NavigationMenu. Compose ElfNavigationMenu > ElfNavigationMenuList > ElfNavigationMenuItem > ElfNavigationMenuTrigger + ElfNavigationMenuContent (links inside) or a top-level ElfNavigationMenuLink variant="trigger". Panels share one animated viewport by default (viewport=false puts each under its item). Use as-child on ElfNavigationMenuLink to render a router link.

Components: `ElfNavigationMenu`, `ElfNavigationMenuList`, `ElfNavigationMenuItem`, `ElfNavigationMenuTrigger`, `ElfNavigationMenuContent`, `ElfNavigationMenuLink`, `ElfNavigationMenuViewport`, `ElfNavigationMenuIndicator`

Props:

- `ElfNavigationMenu viewport` (boolean, default true): Render the shared viewport that all flyout panels grow from; false places each panel under its own trigger.
- `ElfNavigationMenu v-model / defaultValue` (string): The open item (its value); empty string means closed.
- `ElfNavigationMenu delayDuration / skipDelayDuration` (number, default 200 / 300): Hover open delay and the window in which moving between triggers skips it, in ms.
- `ElfNavigationMenu orientation` ('horizontal' | 'vertical', default horizontal): Layout and arrow-key axis.
- `ElfNavigationMenu aria-label` (string): Names the nav landmark; required when the page has more than one navigation.
- `ElfNavigationMenuItem value` (string): Identifies the item; generated when omitted.
- `ElfNavigationMenuLink variant` ('item' | 'trigger', default item): trigger styles a top-level link like a trigger; item styles a link inside a panel.
- `ElfNavigationMenuLink active` (boolean, default false): Marks the current page (aria-current=page).
- `ElfNavigationMenuLink @select` ((event) => void): Emitted when the link is activated.
- `ElfNavigationMenuViewport align` ('start' | 'center' | 'end', default start): Alignment of the panel against the active trigger.
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfNavigationMenu default: the list (and optional custom viewport)
- ElfNavigationMenuTrigger default: the label; a chevron is added
- ElfNavigationMenuContent default: links, grids, any content
- ElfNavigationMenuLink default: the link text (use as-child for a router link)

Accessibility:

- This is the disclosure navigation pattern, not a menu bar: triggers are buttons with aria-expanded, panels hold ordinary links in Tab order. Do not add role=menu.
- Enter or Space opens a flyout, Tab moves into its links, Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger, ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between top-level items.
- Mark the current page with active (aria-current=page). Give the nav an aria-label when there is more than one.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  ElfNavigationMenu,
  ElfNavigationMenuContent,
  ElfNavigationMenuItem,
  ElfNavigationMenuLink,
  ElfNavigationMenuList,
  ElfNavigationMenuTrigger,
} from '@xouyi/elfui'

const gettingStarted = [
  { title: 'Installation', description: 'Add the package and a theme.' },
  { title: 'Theming', description: 'Tokens, themes and radius.' },
  { title: 'Accessibility', description: 'Keyboard and screen reader notes.' },
]
const components = [
  { title: 'Dialog', description: 'A modal window.' },
  { title: 'Tabs', description: 'Sections, one at a time.' },
  { title: 'Tooltip', description: 'A short hint on focus or hover.' },
  { title: 'Sheet', description: 'A panel from the screen edge.' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <ElfNavigationMenu>
    <ElfNavigationMenuList>
      <ElfNavigationMenuItem>
        <ElfNavigationMenuTrigger>Getting started</ElfNavigationMenuTrigger>
        <ElfNavigationMenuContent>
          <ul class="grid w-64 gap-1">
            <li v-for="item in gettingStarted" :key="item.title">
              <ElfNavigationMenuLink href="#">
                <span class="font-medium">{{ item.title }}</span>
                <span class="text-muted-foreground">{{ item.description }}</span>
              </ElfNavigationMenuLink>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </ElfNavigationMenuContent>
      </ElfNavigationMenuItem>
      <ElfNavigationMenuItem>
        <ElfNavigationMenuTrigger>Components</ElfNavigationMenuTrigger>
        <ElfNavigationMenuContent>
          <ul class="grid w-72 gap-1 sm:w-96 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <li v-for="item in components" :key="item.title">
              <ElfNavigationMenuLink href="#">
                <span class="font-medium">{{ item.title }}</span>
                <span class="text-muted-foreground">{{ item.description }}</span>
              </ElfNavigationMenuLink>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </ElfNavigationMenuContent>
      </ElfNavigationMenuItem>
      <ElfNavigationMenuItem>
        <ElfNavigationMenuLink href="#" variant="trigger">
          Docs
        </ElfNavigationMenuLink>
      </ElfNavigationMenuItem>
    </ElfNavigationMenuList>
  </ElfNavigationMenu>
</template>
```

#### Links Only

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  ElfNavigationMenu,
  ElfNavigationMenuItem,
  ElfNavigationMenuLink,
  ElfNavigationMenuList,
} from '@xouyi/elfui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfNavigationMenu :viewport="false" aria-label="Main">
    <ElfNavigationMenuList>
      <ElfNavigationMenuItem>
        <ElfNavigationMenuLink href="#" variant="trigger" active>
          Home
        </ElfNavigationMenuLink>
      </ElfNavigationMenuItem>
      <ElfNavigationMenuItem>
        <ElfNavigationMenuLink href="#" variant="trigger">
          Courses
        </ElfNavigationMenuLink>
      </ElfNavigationMenuItem>
      <ElfNavigationMenuItem>
        <ElfNavigationMenuLink href="#" variant="trigger">
          Stock
        </ElfNavigationMenuLink>
      </ElfNavigationMenuItem>
    </ElfNavigationMenuList>
  </ElfNavigationMenu>
</template>
```

```vue
            </li>
            <li>
              <ElfNavigationMenuLink href="#">
                <span class="font-medium">Guides</span>
                <span class="text-muted-foreground">Short how-to pages.</span>
              </ElfNavigationMenuLink>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </ElfNavigationMenuContent>
      </ElfNavigationMenuItem>
      <ElfNavigationMenuItem>
        <ElfNavigationMenuTrigger>Build</ElfNavigationMenuTrigger>
        <ElfNavigationMenuContent>
```
